integrity: All mathematical statements and proof steps are self-contained. References credit foundational ordinal-pattern work. Calculations can be reproduced using the included standalone source; no external proof or independent review is represented.
scientific_limitations: Proven only for the Lebesgue-stationary full-branch skew tent family, finite positive lags and fixed-coordinate inverse-lag critical windows. The analytic bounds are uniform in lag at fixed parameter but not claimed uniformly over all parameters. Finite exact computations corroborate without certifying all real-parameter cases. Historic priority remains best-knowledge; a plausibly relevant 2022 periodic-point paper was accessible only through metadata and abstract.
title: Two critical windows in the lagged ordinal bias of full-branch skew tent maps
